service_lifecycle.start: start({ port }) resolves { origin, port, stop }; origin = http://127.0.0.1:<actual port>
service_lifecycle.stop: stop() closes server and all connections; idempotent
service_lifecycle.port_precedence: start({ port }) > createServer({ port }) > PORT env > 3000

levels_api_success_shape.body: top-level array of exactly 5 items; item = { id: string(non-empty, unique), name: string(non-empty), difficulty: "简单"|"普通"|"困难", unlocked: boolean }

static_hosting.path_traversal: normalized via node:path; requests escaping staticRoot rejected with 403
